results.name: Side to Side Push Up
instructions: Begin in a standard push-up position with your hands placed slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your body into a push-up, bending both arms but leaning more to the right side, bringing your chest closer to your right hand.
Push through both hands to return to the starting position.

Lower your body into a push-up again, this time leaning more to the left side, bringing your chest closer to your left hand. Continue alternating sides with each push-up for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lower your chest and inhaling as you push back up.
Ensure your hands are placed firmly on the floor to provide stability during the exercise.
Focus on using your chest and triceps muscles to push back up to the starting position.
results.description: Side to Side Push Up is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Smith Machine Press Decline
instructions: Position a decline bench under the smith machine. Adjust the bench so that the barbell is at chest height when lying on the bench.
Lie on the decline bench with your feet secured under the foot pads. Grip the barbell with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it to your chest until it slightly touches it.
Press the barbell back to the starting position, fully extending your arms. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily, exhaling as you press the barbell up and inhaling as you lower it down.
Ensure your feet are securely placed under the foot pads to prevent slipping.
Focus on using your chest muscles to press the weight, avoiding excessive strain on your shoulders.
results.description: Smith Machine Press Decline is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with a smith machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Triceps.

results.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Chest Fly
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles to about waist height. Stand facing away from the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the handles with your palms facing each other.
Engage your core and lean forward, extending your arms straight to the sides to form a T-shape. Your body should be in a straight line from head to heels.
Slowly bring your hands together in front of your chest by squeezing your chest muscles, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Return to the starting position by allowing your arms to extend back to the sides with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you bring your hands together and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Focus on using your chest muscles to bring your hands together, avoiding excessive use of your arms.
Keep your core tight to maintain a straight body line and avoid sagging your hips.
results.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Chest Fly is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Upper Back, Core.

results.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Decline Push-Up
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles to about knee height. Place your feet in the handles, ensuring they are secure, and assume a plank position with your hands placed slightly wider than shoulder-width apart on the floor.
Engage your core, keeping your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest towards the floor, keeping your elbows at a 45-degree angle to your body.
Push through your hands to return to the starting position, straightening your arms. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you push up and inhale as you lower down.
Focus on using your chest and triceps muscles to push yourself up, avoiding excessive use of your shoulders.
Ensure your feet are securely placed in the suspension trainer handles to prevent slipping.
results.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Decline Push-Up is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Shoulders, Core.

results.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Push-Up to Side Plank
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles to about knee height. Place your feet in the handles and assume a push-up position with your hands placed directly under your shoulders, arms fully extended, and body in a straight line from head to heels.
Perform a push-up by bending your elbows and lowering your chest towards the floor while keeping your body straight.
Push back up to the starting position and rotate your body to the right as you reach the top, extending your right arm towards the ceiling to enter a side plank position.
Return to the push-up position and repeat the movement, rotating to the left for the side plank. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Perform the exercise on a non-slip surface to avoid slipping.
Focus on smooth transitions between the push-up and side plank for fluid motion.
Maintain even breathing to help keep your movements controlled and steady.
results.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Push-Up to Side Plank is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Upper Back.

results.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Reverse Push-Up
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles close to the floor. Grasp the handles with an underhand grip (palms facing forward) and position your body in a straight line, feet together and arms fully extended.
Engage your core and maintain a straight line from your head to your heels.
Lower your chest towards the handles by bending your elbows, keeping your body straight and elbows close to your sides.
Press through your hands to extend your arms and return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Perform the movement with a steady and controlled tempo to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Breathe steadily: exhale as you push up and inhale as you lower your body.
Ensure your wrists are under your shoulders to maintain proper alignment.
results.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Reverse Push-Up is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Abdominals, Upper Back.

results.name: Svend Press Decline Bench
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured under the foot pads and your back firmly against the bench. Hold a weight plate with both hands, pressing your palms against the flat sides of the plate at chest level with your fingers pointing up.
Engage your chest and press the weight plate straight out in front of you by extending your arms.
Squeeze your chest muscles as you press the plate outward until your arms are fully extended.
Slowly bring the plate back to your chest with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on pressing through your chest, not your shoulders, to emphasize chest muscle activation.
Choose a weight that challenges you but allows you to maintain proper form.
Avoid locking your elbows completely at the top of the movement to keep tension on the chest muscles.
results.description: Svend Press Decline Bench is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Triceps.
